dedupe_keys.name: survey instrument for modeling household decision making for structural retrofit processes

description: Survey Instrument for Modeling Household Decision-Making for Structural Retrofit Processes is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Rachel Davidson, University of Delaware (udel.edu). The purpose of this survey is to capture how homeowners move through the different stages of decision-making defined by the Precaution Adoption Process Model (PAPM) to install FORTIFIED Roofs on their homes through the Strengthen Your Roof Grant Program administered by the North Carolina Insurance Underwriting Association (NCIUA). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-4nvk-hz85. Keywords: hurricanes,  homeowner decision-making,  Precaution Adoption Process Model,  structural retrofits. Published 2025-05-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
